steps.title: Access Workday Developer Portal
steps.detail: Navigate to https://developer.workday.com/apps and sign in with your Workday account.

steps.title: Create a New OAuth Application
steps.detail: In the portal, select “Create App” (or similar), choose OAuth as the app type, and provide a name and description.

steps.title: Configure Redirect URI and Obtain Credentials
steps.detail: Enter the authorized redirect URI, save the app, and copy the generated client ID and client secret for use in your integration.

openQuestions.question: What is the exact URL of Workday’s developer console or portal where OAuth applications can be created?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Without the correct console URL a developer cannot begin the registration process.
openQuestions.howToResolve: Locate the official Workday developer portal documentation or contact Workday support for the URL.

openQuestions.question: Does Workday require any manual review of OAuth applications before they become active?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Knowing the review timeline affects integration planning.
openQuestions.howToResolve: Check Workday’s API onboarding guides or ask a Workday representative about the review process.

openQuestions.question: Are there any fees associated with creating or maintaining a Workday OAuth app?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Cost impacts budgeting for the integration.
openQuestions.howToResolve: Review Workday’s pricing documentation or inquire with sales.

openQuestions.question: What prerequisite artifacts (e.g., privacy policy, terms of service, verified domain) must be submitted when registering an OAuth app?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Missing required artifacts can block registration.
openQuestions.howToResolve: Examine Workday’s developer onboarding checklist or request the list from Workday support.

openQuestions.question: Are there any identity verification, legal signature, or other human‑only steps required during registration?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Human‑only steps cannot be automated by an AI agent.
openQuestions.howToResolve: Search Workday’s security or compliance documentation for required verification steps.
